entries.title: Timberborn
entries.definitive_edition: Timberborn on Windows PC, version 1.0 or later

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with mod support.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best route because it has the 1.0 full release, modding/Workshop support, and the cleanest capture/settings path. macOS is a valid native route, but Windows PC remains the better support and capture recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current 1.0+ Windows PC version through Steam, Epic, or GOG. Use the native macOS version only if that is your preferred system.

entries.remaster_caveats: Version 1.0 is the full release after Early Access, not a remaster or sequel. Linux is not listed as a native release route; use compatibility layers only if needed.
